SPD state premier campaigns as one-woman bulwark against AfD
cards.text: Manuela Schwesig, of the center-left SPD, has governed the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, on the Baltic Sea coast, since 2017. Ahead of this weekend's election, she is campaigning against the nationalist AfD.

cards.title: Holocaust survivor on 'very dangerous' AfD Saxony-Anhalt win
cards.text: Charlotte Knobloch survived the Holocaust by passing as the daughter of non-Jewish farmers. She recently spoke with DW to express her shock following the AfD victory in Saxony-Anhalt's state election.

cards.title: Drivers in Germany fume over soaring fuel prices
cards.text: Chancellor Friedrich Merz wants to provide relief to motorists. But exactly how this is to happen remains unclear.

cards.title: Turkey's rights groups, EU call out LGBTQ+ crackdown
cards.text: Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations — and also from Brussels.

cards.title: How extreme heat is hitting wallets
cards.text: Heat waves, wildfires and floods have cascading economic impacts, causing incomes to decline and the price of basic goods to rise. The trend will escalate as temperatures continue to increase.

cards.title: German drama 'Blindspot Berlin' revisits 2016 Christmas market attack
cards.text: A decade after the terrorist attack on a Berlin Christmas market, a new German miniseries looks into the institutional failures that allowed the deadly truck rampage to happen.

cards.title: Kosovo ex-president Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
cards.text: A Hague tribunal ruled that Hashim Thaci, a former leader of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), is responsible for war crimes carried out during the war of independence with Serbia.

cards.title: Global Gender Gap Report: Women's hard-won gains 'fragile'
cards.text: Two decades of progress toward gender parity is at risk as women's political representation declines, according to a new World Economic Forum report. At the current pace, the remaining gap could take 120 years to close.

cards.title: Poland reaffirms support for Ukraine after drone strikes
cards.text: After Russia's recent drone attacks on targets close to the Ukraine-Poland border, Warsaw has doubled down on its support for Kyiv and pledged a "nonprovocative but serious response" to Moscow.

cards.title: After Neuer: Who will be Germany's new No. 1 goalkeeper?
cards.text: Following Manuel Neuer's retirement, there are many candidates to succeed him, but which goalkeeper will Jürgen Klopp choose? What factors will play a role? And will Neuer's future have an indirect influence?

cards.title: British-American writer Bonnie Greer dies aged 77
cards.text: Chicago-born playwright Bonnie Greer, who became a familiar face in British political discourse later in life, has died. Her husband David Hutchins announced news of Greer's death.

cards.title: Shock in Kosovo as Hague convicts former President Thaci
cards.text: The conviction in The Hague of former President Hashim Thaci and three former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has caused consternation in Kosovo — both among political leaders and on the streets. DW reports from Pristina.

cards.title: Chancellor Merz seeks CDU support amid far-right AfD surge
cards.text: Following the CDU's crushing defeat in the Saxony-Anhalt state election, many are expressing doubts about the party's leader, Chancellor Friedrich Merz. But the CDU doesn't appear to have a viable alternative.

cards.title: Can Canada and the EU deepen ties to counter Trump?
cards.text: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is known for standing up to US President Donald Trump. Now he wants to forge a "unique alliance" with Europe. But what could such a partnership look like?

cards.title: UK: Village votes to 'secede' in asylum center plan protest
cards.text: Residents of Piddington, a tiny, remote village in Oxfordshire in England, have staged a "referendum" on leaving the UK. They are objecting to plans to open an asylum reception center at a disused military base nearby.

cards.title: How climate change worsened Nepal's deadly mountain collapse
cards.text: A glacier and rock collapse in Nepal killed nearly 1,400 people and left thousands missing. Scientists say decades of warming helped set the disaster in motion.

cards.title: Saint, sinner or feminist icon: How Mary Magdalene's image evolved through time
cards.text: From "Apostle of the Apostles" to prostitute, Mary Magdalene has been assigned a wide variety of roles, as a new exhibition shows.

cards.title: India news: New Delhi denies claims world leaders fell ill after BRICS summit
